summary.text:
Global equities tumbled amid an accelerating AI sell-off. The Nasdaq fell 5.61% to 25028.98 and the S&P 500 declined 3.7% to 6910.39, with the VIX surging 26.2% to 35.89. Nvidia plunged 13.83% to 125.79 as chip stocks faced broad liquidation and ARK reduced its Nvidia stake. Internationally, the Nikkei 225 dropped 4.82% and the DAX lost 2.45%.

In FX, the dollar index fell 0.06% to 103.84, with USDJPY dropping 0.55% to 158.512 and EURUSD gaining 0.02% to 1.0975. In commodities, gold slid 3.98% to 3539.0 and Brent lost 2.29% to 89.87, while WTI rose 0.49% to 83.62. Bitcoin dropped 4.7% to 58993.12.

Looking ahead, participants are tracking tech policy after Bessent affirmed Nvidia export rules are unchanged following Trump discussing Jensen Huang with Xi. Private market sentiment also remains in focus as Databricks targets a 225 billion dollar valuation in a new funding round.
